image_description: A close-up portrait of a brown tabby cat sitting outdoors next to a tree trunk. The cat is facing forward, looking directly at the camera. Tall green grass blades partially obscure the right side of the cat's body and face. The background is a soft-focus garden scene.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly visible and conforms to the standard domestic cat morphology with a rounded skull and proportionate muzzle.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pattern appears to be a mix of mackerel (stripes on legs/cheeks) and possibly classic/swirled on the chest, fitting the general tabby definition.

artifact_observations.location: Right eye pupil and iris boundary
artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflection in the right eye (viewer's left) appears slightly smeared compared to the sharp catchlight in the left eye. The boundary between the pupil and iris is slightly soft, suggesting minor generative smoothing.

artifact_observations.location: Intersection of grass blades and cat's right shoulder
artifact_observations.reasoning: Several blades of grass appear to merge into the fur texture rather than sitting cleanly on top or behind it. There is a slight 'bleeding' effect where the green of the grass mixes with the brown fur without a sharp occlusion boundary.

artifact_observations.location: Whiskers on the right side (viewer's left)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The whiskers on the left side of the face seem to fade out abruptly or blend into the background blur more naturally than the right side, which maintains sharpness longer. Slight inconsistency in depth-of-field rendering.

To verify the structural integrity of the visible head and neck alignment, ensuring no subtle warping in the facial structure despite the static pose.
To specifically audit the occlusion boundaries between the complex foreground grass and the cat's fur, checking for the merging artifacts noted by the Router.
To assess overall photorealism, lighting consistency, and detect any high-frequency noise or unnatural smoothness in the fur texture.

focus_areas: Occlusion boundaries between grass and fur
Symmetry and clarity of eye reflections
Consistency of tabby stripe patterns across visible body parts
Structural plausibility of the head-neck connection
